# TDrive v3.1.3

This release groups shared drives in the mobile Account screen. The release
workflow now requires the iOS IPA before publishing, so a release cannot
silently omit the installable iPhone build.

## Mobile shared drives

- Show joined shared drives inside a Shared folder in Account as well as the
  drive switcher on Home.
- Open a shared drive directly from either Shared folder, while keeping the
  shared drive list free of an unnecessary search field.

## Release packages

- Require the freshly built unsigned iOS IPA and verify it is present before
  assembling and publishing the release assets.
